name: Umbro
verdict: Umbro is a brand of Iconix Brand Group, controlled since August 2021 by Avram Glazer and his trust through Iconix Acquisition LLC. Nothing found.
note: Rating note: Kit maker (technical sponsor) of Rayo Vallecano, recorded as partner per the convention for kit suppliers. The brand has belonged to Iconix Brand Group since Nike sold it in December 2012; Iconix went private in 2021 under Avram Glazer's trust (SEC filings). No state or fund in the chain, and no court, regulator, UN body or major-NGO human-rights finding against Umbro, Iconix or Lancer Capital found.
